name: Flags · Look-alikes
description: Tell the twins apart: Chad or Romania, Indonesia or Monaco, Norway or Iceland, and the other flags everyone mixes up.

cards.label: flag
cards.hook: Six white stars (a big Commonwealth Star and five of the Southern Cross); NZ's are red.

cards.label: flag
cards.hook: Four red stars edged in white; Australia's flag has six white ones.

cards.label: flag
cards.hook: Darker red and blue than Luxembourg's, on a shorter flag.

cards.label: flag
cards.hook: Longer than the Dutch flag, with a sky-blue stripe and a lighter red.

cards.label: flag
cards.hook: Green, white, red: where Ireland has orange, Italy has red.

cards.label: flag
cards.hook: Green at the hoist, orange at the fly; Ivory Coast reverses it on a squarer flag.

cards.label: flag
cards.hook: Orange at the hoist: Ireland's tricolour reversed, on a less oblong flag.

cards.label: flag
cards.hook: Red with a navy cross edged in white; Iceland is blue with a red cross.

cards.label: flag
cards.hook: Blue with a red cross edged in white; Norway swaps the colours.

cards.label: flag
cards.hook: White, blue, red with no emblem; Slovakia and Slovenia add a shield.

cards.label: flag
cards.hook: Shield with a white double cross at the hoist; Slovenia's shows Mount Triglav.

cards.label: flag
cards.hook: Small shield with Mount Triglav high in the corner; Slovakia's shield is bigger.

cards.label: flag
cards.hook: Red on top, 2:3, and a slightly lighter red than Monaco's.

cards.label: flag
cards.hook: Squarer (4:5) than Indonesia's 2:3, with a slightly darker red.

cards.label: flag
cards.hook: White on top, red below; Indonesia and Monaco put the red on top.

cards.label: flag
cards.hook: Plain stripes in a lighter blue than Chad's; Andorra and Moldova add arms.

cards.label: flag
cards.hook: Indigo blue, darker than Romania's; the stripes are otherwise the same.

cards.label: flag
cards.hook: Arms with two cows; a squarer flag (7:10) than Moldova's long 1:2.

cards.label: flag
cards.hook: Eagle and aurochs-head shield in the arms; Andorra's arms show cows.

cards.label: flag
cards.hook: Plain, with a double-height yellow band; Ecuador adds arms, Venezuela stars.

cards.label: flag
cards.hook: Coat of arms with a condor in the centre; otherwise the same as Colombia's.

cards.label: flag
cards.hook: An arc of eight white stars on the blue band; Colombia has none.

cards.label: flag
cards.hook: Maroon, nine white points, very long (11:28); Bahrain is red with five.

cards.label: flag
cards.hook: Red with five white points; Qatar's is maroon with nine, and much longer.

cards.label: flag
cards.hook: Plain green, yellow, red; Guinea reverses the order, Senegal adds a star.

cards.label: flag
cards.hook: A green star on the yellow stripe; Mali and Guinea have none.

cards.label: flag
cards.hook: Red at the hoist: Mali's order reversed, with no star like Senegal's.

cards.label: flag
cards.hook: Five blue stars on the white stripe and no emblem, unlike Nicaragua and El Salvador.

cards.label: flag
cards.hook: A rainbow triangle ringed by gold lettering; El Salvador's adds flags and a wreath.

cards.label: flag
cards.hook: Rainbow triangle with flags, a laurel wreath and a scroll; Nicaragua's has none.
